summary: 54-year-old male hiker tripped while descending toward the trailhead in the area of Lake Isabelle, injuring his knee and unable to walk; Indian Peaks Fire Protection District and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group hiked in, provided medical care, packaged him in a full-body splint and litter, and evacuated him to the trailhead; AMR paramedics evaluated him and transported by ambulance to a local hospital.
location: area of Lake Isabelle, Brainard Lake Recreation Area
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Indian Peaks Fire Protection District; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; AMR Ambulance
